project.title: MAHAL
project.description: A short film written by my friends where I participated as an actor. The project was inspired by our love for indie films and the song "Mahal Magmahal" by Esremborak.

project.title: Pagpasok sa Pagiging Batang Ina
project.description: A speech piece about coming of age and embracing responsibility through becoming a mother to a cat.

project.title: Unboxing
project.description: An editorial piece inspired by Hidilyn Diaz's Olympic journey. It explores how women continue to break free from misogynistic standards in sports while highlighting the challenges athletes face due to limited support and funding.
